## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the requirement and before/after result. Link the parent task and task contract.

## Scope and revisions

Base/dependency commits, candidate intent/source snapshot, exact tool/ruleset versions,
writable paths and file-ownership record. Explain any approved scope change.

## Evidence and four reviews

Link the requirements matrix, actual checks/results, schematic/PCB views and calculations.
Link Reality Checker, Overengineering, Completeness and Change Reviewer reports on this
candidate, plus the finding ledger and independent closure evidence.

## Integration and human review

Identify stale/repeated reviews, whole-project checks and the stage packet.
Record genuine human decisions and merge authorization when supplied.
A merged PR is not automatic approval of the next stage or manufacturing.

## Limits and follow-up

Open questions/owners/blocked stages, approved scoped deviations and deferred items.
For a release, link matched manufacturing data and bring-up/integration plan.
